questions.question_english: In any establishment other than a factory, mine, or government department, who is deemed the Principal Employer under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970?
options_english: Any person responsible for the supervision and control of the establishment
The registered owner or landlord of the physical building premises
The designated assistant manager or lowest administrative staff on site
The District Magistrate or Collector overseeing the local jurisdiction
questions.explanation_english: Section 2(1)(g)(iv) specifies that in any other establishment, the Principal Employer is any person responsible for the supervision and control of the establishment. This statutory rule ensures that executive operational authority carries explicit statutory responsibility for registering the establishment, monitoring contractor compliance, providing required amenities, and safeguarding worker rights under the Act.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अनुबंध श्रम (नियमन और उन्मूलन) अधिनियम, 1970 की धारा 2(1)(g)(iv) में कहा गया है कि किसी अन्य प्रतिष्ठान में, मुख्य नियोक्ता वह व्यक्ति है जो प्रतिष्ठान की देखरेख और नियंत्रण के लिए जिम्मेदार है। यह वैधानिक नियम सुनिश्चित करता है कि कार्यकारी संचालन प्राधिकरण के पास प्रतिष्ठान को पंजीकृत करने, ठेकेदार की अनुपालन की निगरानी करने, आवश्यक सुविधाएं प्रदान करने और अधिनियम के तहत श्रमिकों के अधिकारों की सुरक्षा करने की स्पष्ट वैधानिक जिम्मेदारी हो।
questions.topic: Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970

Printed answer key: (A) Any person responsible for the supervision

questions.question_english: The Delhi Government decides to abolish contract labour in the activity of ‘teaching’ in all government schools, determining it to be a perennial, core activity necessary for the establishment. According to the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970, what is the correct legal sequence for this abolition?
options_english: Government issues order → Consults Advisory Board → Publishes Notification
Publishes Notification → Approves in Legislative Assembly → Consults Advisory Board
School Principals pass a resolution → Government issues order → Board approves
Consults Advisory Board → Considers conditions of Sec 10(2) → Publishes Notification in Official Gazette
questions.explanation_english: The correct sequence involves consulting the Advisory Board, considering the conditions outlined in Section 10(2), which includes the perennial nature of the work and the necessity for a regular workforce, followed by publishing a formal notification in the Official Gazette to complete the legal abolition process.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। इसमें सलाहकार बोर्ड से परामर्श करना, धारा 10(2) में उल्लिखित शर्तों पर विचार करना, जिसमें कार्य की स्थायी प्रकृति और नियमित कार्यबल की आवश्यकता शामिल है, और फिर आधिकारिक राजपत्र में एक औपचारिक अधिसूचना प्रकाशित करना शामिल है, ताकि कानूनी उन्मूलन प्रक्रिया पूरी हो सके।
questions.topic: Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970

questions.question_english: Under Section 8 of the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970, under what circumstances can the registration of an establishment be revoked?
options_english: If the principal employer changes the nature of establishment work to a completely different core activity.
If registration was obtained by misrepresentation or suppression of material facts.
If the primary contractor demands a significantly higher financial rate for supplying contract labour.
If the total number of deployed contract workers temporarily falls below twenty for a period of one week.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that registration was obtained by misrepresentation or suppression of material facts. Section 8 provides that if the Registering Officer is satisfied that registration was obtained by misrepresentation or suppression of any material fact, or if the registration has become ineffective, the officer may revoke the registration after giving the Principal Employer an opportunity to be heard.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। यदि पंजीकरण गलत जानकारी या सामग्री तथ्यों को छिपाने के द्वारा प्राप्त किया गया था। अनुच्छेद 8 में कहा गया है कि यदि पंजीकरण अधिकारी संतुष्ट है कि पंजीकरण गलत जानकारी या सामग्री तथ्यों को छिपाने के द्वारा प्राप्त किया गया था, या यदि पंजीकरण अप्रभावी हो गया है, तो अधिकारी प्रधान नियोक्ता को सुनवाई का अवसर देने के बाद पंजीकरण रद्द कर सकता है।
questions.topic: Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970
key_facts: Section 8 allows revocation of registration for misrepresentation.
The Principal Employer must be given a chance to be heard.
Printed answer key: (B) If registration was obtained by misrepresentation or suppression of material facts.

options_english: Establishment — Any commercial establishment or manufacturing unit registered under the Factories Act
Contractor — Any supplier or individual who merely supplies goods or raw materials to the establishment
Workman — Any individual who is employed in a purely managerial or administrative capacity on site
Principal Employer (in a Government Office) — The Head of office or officer specified by Government
questions.explanation_english: The correct definition of Principal Employer (in a Government Office) is the Head of office or officer specified by Government. Under Section 2(1)(g)(i), in relation to any office or department of the Government, this definition is accurate. Other options distort statutory definitions regarding material suppliers, establishments under the Act, and excluded managerial positions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। सरकारी कार्यालय में प्रधान नियोक्ता का सही परिभाषा कार्यालय का प्रमुख या सरकार द्वारा निर्दिष्ट अधिकारी है। धारा 2(1)(ग)(i) के तहत, किसी भी सरकारी कार्यालय या विभाग के संबंध में, यह परिभाषा सही है। अन्य विकल्प सामग्री आपूर्तिकर्ताओं, अधिनियम के तहत संस्थानों और प्रबंधकीय पदों को छोड़ने के संबंध में वैधानिक परिभाषाओं को विकृत करते हैं।

questions.question_english: Does the Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act apply if the contractor employs 20 or more workmen on any day?
options_english: Yes, if the contractor employs 20 or more workmen.
No, government educational institutions are completely exempt.
Yes, but he must obtain five separate individual licenses from the central government.
No, it only applies to private institutions.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'It applies if the contractor employs 20 or more workmen on any day of the preceding 12 months.' Under Section 1(4)(b) of the Act, the statutory provisions apply directly to every contractor who employs twenty or more workmen on any day of the preceding twelve months. Thus, applicability to a contractor depends on meeting this workforce threshold, imposing direct statutory responsibilities regarding licensing, wage distribution, and worker welfare amenities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। यह सही है कि यह तब लागू होता है जब ठेकेदार किसी दिन 20 या अधिक श्रमिकों को रोजगार देता है। अधिनियम की धारा 1(4)(ख) के तहत, वैधानिक प्रावधान सीधे उन सभी ठेकेदारों पर लागू होते हैं जो पिछले बारह महीनों में किसी दिन 20 या अधिक श्रमिकों को रोजगार देते हैं। इसलिए, ठेकेदार के लिए लागूता इस कार्यबल मानदंड को पूरा करने पर निर्भर करती है, जो लाइसेंसिंग, वेतन वितरण और श्रमिक कल्याण सुविधाओं के संबंध में सीधे वैधानिक जिम्मेदारियों को लागू करती है।
questions.topic: Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970
key_facts: Section 1(4)(b) applies to contractors employing 20 or more workmen.
Applicability depends on meeting the workforce threshold.
Printed answer key: (D) It applies if the contractor employs 20 or more workmen on any day.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following conditions relating to 'Contract Labour':
I. Hired in connection with the work of an establishment.
II. Hired through a contractor.
III. Hired with the mandatory written consent of the principal employer.
IV. Hired for hire or reward.
Which of the above are the essential statutory components of the definition under Section 2(1)(b) of the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970?
questions.explanation_english: Section 2(1)(b) specifies three fundamental components: being hired in connection with the work of an establishment, being hired by or through a contractor, and working for hire or reward. Written consent of the principal employer is not a legal requirement, as hiring can occur with or without the employer’s knowledge.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। धारा 2(1)(b) में तीन मौलिक घटकों का उल्लेख किया गया है: एक प्रतिष्ठान के काम से संबंधित काम पर नियुक्त होना, एक ठेकेदार के माध्यम से नियुक्त होना, और वेतन या इनाम के लिए काम करना। प्रमुख नियोक्ता की लिखित सहमति एक कानूनी आवश्यकता नहीं है, क्योंकि नियुक्ति नियोक्ता की जानकारी के बिना भी हो सकती है।
questions.topic: Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970
key_facts: Section 2(1)(b) outlines essential components of contract labour.
Printed answer key: (c) I, II and IV

questions.question_english: What is the consequence under Section 9 if a Principal Employer fails to get the establishment registered within the prescribed time?
options_english: The establishment must pay double registration fees and continue its ongoing operations uninterrupted.
The primary contractor automatically assumes all statutory duties as the new Principal Employer.
The Principal Employer is prohibited from employing contract labour in the establishment.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that the Principal Employer is prohibited from employing contract labour in the establishment. questions.question_english: The Certificate of Registration issued to an establishment contains which of the following details?
options_english: The maximum number of contract labour to be employed in the establishment
The names of all contract labourers currently employed
The daily wage rate of the regular employees of the establishment
The profit margin agreed upon between the principal employer and contractor
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option A. Under Section 7(2) and the rules, the Certificate of Registration issued in Form II specifies essential administrative details, including the name and address of the establishment, type of business, and the maximum number of contract workers authorized to be employed on any given day. This ensures compliance with the regulations set forth in the Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अनुबंध श्रमिकों के पंजीकरण प्रमाणपत्र में आवश्यक प्रशासनिक विवरण शामिल होते हैं, जिसमें प्रतिष्ठान का नाम और पता, व्यवसाय का प्रकार, और किसी भी दिन नियोजित अनुबंध श्रमिकों की अधिकतम संख्या शामिल होती है। यह अनुबंध श्रमिकों के नियमन के लिए आवश्यकताओं का पालन सुनिश्चित करता है।
questions.topic: Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970
key_facts: Section 7(2) specifies details for the Certificate of Registration.
Form II is used for issuing the Certificate of Registration.
The certificate includes the maximum number of contract workers allowed.
Printed answer key: (A) The maximum number of contract labour to be employed in the establishment

questions.question_english:
What is the minimum notice period required to
be given by the appropriate Government before
applying the Contract Labour (Regulation
and Abolition) Act, 1970 to an establishment
employing less than the specified threshold of
workmen?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Under the proviso to Section 1(4) of the Act, the appropriate Government must give a minimum notice period of not less than two months by notification in the Official Gazette before applying the provisions of the legislation to any establishment or contractor employing fewer than the statutory threshold of twenty workmen.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। अधिनियम की धारा 1(4) के प्रावधान के अनुसार, उपयुक्त सरकार को किसी भी संस्थान या ठेकेदार पर इस कानून के प्रावधानों को लागू करने से पहले आधिकारिक गजट में अधिसूचना द्वारा कम से कम दो महीने का नोटिस देना आवश्यक है, जब काम करने वालों की संख्या 20 से कम हो।
questions.topic: Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970
key_facts: Minimum notice period is two months as per Section 1(4).
Applicable to establishments with fewer than 20 workmen.

options_english: The contractor has formed a trade union
The licence was obtained by misrepresentation

questions.explanation_english: Section 14 empowers the licensing officer to revoke, suspend, or forfeit a licence’s security deposit if the licence was obtained by misrepresentation or suppression of material facts, or if the contractor has failed to comply with any statutory licence conditions or provisions of the Act.
